Vaibhava
cited by Madhva, not extant.
See BNK. Sharma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. Vol. p. 357.

Vaibhavacandrikā
by Vīrarāghva Śaṭhakopa Yatīndra, 37th Azhagiasingar of the Ahobila Mutt. Ahobila 37.

Vaibhavatantra
pāñcarātra. enumerated among Pāñcarātra tantras, MT. 1343 (C.. [Page035-a.

Vaibhavaprakāśikāvedāntācāryacaritra)
by S. Veṅkaṭācārya (sic.). Oppert I. 483. II. 4173. Govt. Or. Libr. Madras 90 (a.).
-by Śrīnivāsa Mahāsūri. Govt. Ori. Libr. Madras 43. Śg. I. 137. VVRI. I. p. 246.

Vaibhavavilāsa
by Vijayarāghavācārya.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. sn. 254.

Vaibhavasaṃhitā
Pāñcarātra text, mentioned in a list of 219 Pāñcarātrasaṃhitās, see Lalṣmītantra, Adyar Libr. Ser. 87, Intr. p.. 10-12.

Vaibhaveṣṭi
regarding certain rites to be performed by one who seeks to become a Vaiṣṇava. Adyar II. p. 229a. MD. 3790. MT. 6410. PUL. I. p. 91.

Vaibhāvya
cited by Madhva. Not extant. See BNK. Sharma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. Vol. I. p. 357.

Vaibhāṣikakośa
lex. in 11 cantos, by Kṛṣṇakavi, son of Lakṣmaṇa an. Mallikā. written in 4869 Kali year. MD. 1756. Mysore I. p. 609. Mysore N. D. XV. 47723. 47724. Extr. p. 449.
